ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) surface with high-intensity (white) localized punctate specks; ratio of high-intensity pixels to low-intensity pixels is approximately 1:15.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniform dark-pixel distribution across >90% of the fluke. Distinct high-contrast white/yellowish contiguous clusters localized at the extreme distal tips. Discrete, non-contiguous white spots (1-3 pixels) scattered semi-randomly across the medial and lateral regions of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Obtuse V-shaped depression with a calculated angle of approximately 130 degrees and a depth of approximately 12% of the vertical lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular, high-frequency micro-serrations with pixel amplitudes ranging from 2-8 pixels along the posterior boundary, particularly visible on the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Slightly concave trailing edge sweep from the median notch to the lateral tips; leading edge is partially obscured but suggests a convex curvature.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized high-contrast white clusters at the distal tips of both fluke lobes (barnacle colonization). Frequent small, roughly circular high-intensity spots distributed across the ventral black surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant white/yellowish accretion clusters at the far lateral margins of both lobes; potential small indentations on the trailing edge of the right lobe.
